overridesJustification.babel-plugin-istanbul: CVE-2026-14257 (brace-expansion DoS, GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg). @jest/transform pins babel-plugin-istanbul ^7.0.1, whose test-exclude 6.x resolves glob 7 -> minimatch 3 -> brace-expansion 1.1.16. The 1.x line has no patched release, and jest is already at its latest version, so no parent bump resolves this. babel-plugin-istanbul 8 pairs with test-exclude 7, which resolves a patched brace-expansion. Remove this override once @jest/transform depends on babel-plugin-istanbul ^8.
